extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions for each figure of the dance. She demonstrates the movements for both boys and girls, ensuring the audience understands the gender-specific roles.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the dance, Cariñosa.
The teacher breaks down Figure 1: Three Steps and a Point.
The teacher breaks down Figure 2: Pointing.
The teacher breaks down Figure 3: Back-to-back.
The teacher breaks down Figure 4: Hide and seek with fan.
The teacher breaks down Figure 5: Kneeling and Fanning.
The teacher breaks down Figure 6: Hide and seek with the Handkerchief.

cues: Put your hands at the back
metaphors: Make a movement like saying a no

steps_taught.name: Three Steps and a Point
steps_taught.description: Step right foot sideward, close left foot, and point left foot.

steps_taught.name: Pointing
steps_taught.description: Take three steps forward, pause, and point right foot.

steps_taught.name: Back-to-back
steps_taught.description: Take three steps forward, face back, and point right foot.

steps_taught.name: Hide and seek with fan
steps_taught.description: Take three steps forward, pause, and open fan while pointing.

steps_taught.name: Kneeling and Fanning
steps_taught.description: Take three steps forward, kneel on left foot, and fan.

steps_taught.name: Hide and seek with the Handkerchief
steps_taught.description: Take three steps forward, pause, and use handkerchief.

quotes.text: Today, I'm going to teach you how to dance Cariñosa.
The figure one is called three step and a point.
The figure two is called pointing.
The figure three is called back-to-back.
The figure four is called hide and seek with fan.
The figure five is called kneeling and fanning.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of the camera and introduces the dance.
The teacher demonstrates the three-step and point movement.
The teacher explains the pointing figure.
The teacher demonstrates the back-to-back figure.
The teacher explains the hide and seek with fan figure.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher explicitly separates the instructions for boys and girls, providing specific movements for each.
